patterns.note: Full-width sections with content consistently centered within a generous max-width container, creating a spacious and organized visual flow.
A single, clean sans-serif typeface (Diatype) is used across all text elements, maintaining a consistent modern and highly readable aesthetic for both headings and body copy.
A restrained and sophisticated color palette primarily uses white backgrounds and dark text, accented by a distinctive muted green that directly reflects the product's physical design.

The main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport throughout the scroll, maintaining its original size and style without any transformation, ensuring constant brand presence and navigation access.
Prominent, full-bleed hero section features an auto-playing background video with a subtle dark overlay, immediately showcasing the product in context with dynamic visuals.

technique_notes: A full-bleed hero section incorporates an auto-playing background video with a semi-transparent dark overlay to ensure text legibility, paired with a clear call-to-action button positioned over the video.
The primary navigation bar is fixed to the top of the viewport, maintaining its initial size and styling without any visual changes or shrinking as the user scrolls down the page.

Content sections are structured with generous vertical padding and margins, revealing by simply scrolling into the viewport without complex entrance animations like fades or slides, relying on clear visual hierarchy.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) create strong visual hierarchy, complemented by a highly readable, lighter-weight body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (e.g., 4-8px) on buttons and interactive elements, contributing to a soft and approachable feel without being overly rounded.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, characterized by significant vertical spacing between major content sections and generous internal padding within blocks, creating a calm and uncluttered layout.

standout: The site's standout feature is its elegant integration of the product's distinctive muted green color directly into the brand's visual identity, creating a cohesive and sophisticated aesthetic. This, combined with the spacious, image-rich layout and clean typography, elevates the product beyond mere utility to a lifestyle choice, making it feel premium and desirable.
